items.name: tokens
items.title: Tokens
items.description: The design tokens and global CSS: the ink-blue dark ramp and the paper light ramp, state, signal, env and data-ink colours, the font families, the seven-step type scale, gutters, motion timings, the caps label utilities, the @position-try fallbacks for anchored popovers, and the reduced-motion catch-all. Replaces src/index.css; Tailwind CSS v4.

items.name: fonts
items.title: Fonts
items.description: The font files, from Fontsource packages, imported once. The families they declare are named in the tokens.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: `cn` (clsx + tailwind-merge) and the date helpers every surface formats with.

items.name: env
items.title: Environment colours
items.description: Environment names, labels and the one place env colour comes from: dev green, qa sky, staging violet, prod rose, anything else neutral.

items.name: theme-constants
items.title: Tool accents
items.description: TOOL_ACCENTS: the one source of a tool’s identity colour.

items.name: popover
items.title: Anchored popovers
items.description: Native popovers placed with CSS anchor positioning: anchor names, placement styles, and a measured fallback for browsers without anchor positioning. No portals, no z-index.

items.name: view-transition
items.title: View transitions
items.description: `withViewTransition` for whole-page swaps (env, theme) and `TRANSITION_PANE` for the pane a list navigation swaps.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast manager
items.description: The global Base UI toast manager: raise a toast from anywhere, inside React or not.

items.name: use-copy
items.title: useCopy
items.description: Copy to the clipboard and hold a "copied" state long enough to be seen.

items.name: ui-store
items.title: UI store
items.description: Client state no server owns (theme, rail, overlays) in Zustand, and the effect that applies the theme class to <html>.

items.name: api-types
items.title: API types
items.description: The API’s shapes under the names the UI uses, re-exported from types generated from the backend’s openapi.json.

items.name: identity
items.title: Identity
items.description: Who is asking: the bearer credential, the admin view-as lens, and `identityGeneration`, the one number that moves whenever the account, the lens or a grant changes.

items.name: api-client
items.title: API client
items.description: `apiFetch` with the credential and view-as headers, `APIError` and `IdentityChangedError`, and the app’s one QueryClient.

items.name: identity-bound-mutation
items.title: useIdentityBoundMutation
items.description: The only way to write: a TanStack mutation that belongs, start to finish, to the identity that started it, so retries, rollbacks and invalidations never act for somebody else.

items.name: scopes
items.title: Scopes
items.description: The scope grammar (`<tool>:<action>[:<qualifier>]`, `inEnv`, `inAnyEnv`, `can`, `canAny`) checked against the shared scope-contract.json, `useScopes()` over /auth/me, and the cache boundaries an identity change enforces.

items.name: config
items.title: useConfig
items.description: GET /config: the app name, the environments, and which of them apply writes directly.

items.name: resource-links
items.title: Resource links
items.description: The typed vocabulary of shareable URLs: every linkable resource and the path it opens.

items.name: section-header
items.title: SectionHeader
items.description: Every section head: `page` (display 15px, a reading on the right), `pane` (caps label with a hairline), `pane danger`; with SECTION_GAP and SECTION_HEAD_GAP.

items.name: fold
items.title: Fold
items.description: `Fold`, `FoldRow` and `ShowMore` on Base UI Collapsible: a turning left chevron, dashed rules, actions outside the trigger, bodies kept mounted for find-in-page.

items.name: hint
items.title: Hint and InfoTip
items.description: `Hint` names a control on hover or focus; `InfoTip` and `InfoTerm` hand over the sentence behind a word on a press. Both are native popovers anchored to their trigger; no native title anywhere.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A native-popover menu: arrows, Home, End and type-ahead, closes on Escape, Tab or a press outside, and hands focus back to its trigger.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: The empty state, in page, inspector and inline sizes.

items.name: error-state
items.title: ErrorState
items.description: "Couldn’t load {noun}", a detail and one soft Retry, in page, inspector and inline sizes; and the ErrorBoundary that renders it.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: The one owner of the loading shimmer. No spinners.

items.name: state-mark
items.title: StateMark
items.description: Health as an 8px mark (6px in dense rows) in the state tokens, always paired with a word for readers.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A status word: `tone`, `soft` for a fill, `mono` for values, and a `hint`.

items.name: env-signal
items.title: EnvSignal
items.description: An environment, named in its own colour family. Never a loud badge.

items.name: list-card
items.title: ListCard
items.description: The one row recipe: a card with a column-label header and hairlines, `ListCard.Surface` rows at 40, 48 or 56px, the solid hover and the one selection mark.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: A box of fields: `well`, `card` or `framed`, at rounded-lg.

items.name: button
items.title: Button, IconButton, CopyButton
items.description: One ink primary, soft secondaries and the consequence tier (glass-amber, glass-rose, glass-emerald, danger) at three heights. Every control that changes something is refused under a view-as lens. `IconButton` names itself through its hint; `CopyButton` is every copy.

items.name: input
items.title: Input, Textarea, Field
items.description: Text inputs at the control heights, and the labelled field around them.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key or a chord, in mono nano.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: The modal on Base UI Dialog: focus trap, Escape, focus return, glass, an entry that settles from 95%.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: The side sheet on Base UI Dialog, for create and edit forms.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: A radio group whose one pill is anchored to the checked option, so a new choice slides it across.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Base UI Switch in the tokens.

items.name: toaster
items.title: Toaster
items.description: The toast viewport on Base UI Toast, and `notifyWithLink` / `notifyFailure`: a toast that links to the resource or the request, and the one way a failure is announced.

items.name: metric-track
items.title: MetricTrack and MetricStrip
items.description: The quiet-columns chart: `MetricTrack` for a bar chart, `MetricStrip` for the same columns at row height, `MetricAxis` for a shared clock. Data ink, colour only when a reading went wrong, one tab stop with arrow-key buckets.

items.name: resource-anchor
items.title: ResourceAnchor
items.description: A router link to any resource in the ResourceLink vocabulary.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: ThemeToggle
items.description: Dark and light, crossfaded through a view transition.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: CommandPalette
items.description: The ⌘K palette on cmdk inside a Base UI Dialog: every tool the principal can open, and each tool’s own commands from the registry.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: shadcn’s Message in the tokens: one turn of a conversation, aligned to who said it, with a header, content and footer.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: shadcn’s Bubble in the tokens: `filled` for the person’s words on the accent fill, `plain` for the assistant’s as reading text.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: MessageScroller
items.description: shadcn’s Message Scroller in the tokens: pinned to the newest turn while an answer streams, let go when the reader scrolls up, with an IconButton back down.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: The console frame: the chrome (rail and top bar as one L), the inset workspace, the environment breadcrumb with its coloured top edge and the approval banner, view-as, the user menu, Home, the theme toggle and the palette, wired to the router and providers. Installs main.tsx, App.tsx and router.tsx.

items.name: tool-registry
items.title: Tool registry
items.description: TOOL_REGISTRY, the one list every surface is built from (rail, Home tiles, palette, routes), `ToolBoundary` in front of every tool view, and the contribution slots a tool fills on shared surfaces.

items.name: approvals
items.title: Approvals
items.description: The two-person rule: the review inbox, the resource registry each tool adds one entry to, the queue and decision hooks, and `useNeedsApproval`, which an approval-aware action hook asks before submit.

items.name: example-tool
items.title: Example tool: feature flags
items.description: The tool to copy from: a list column and a detail pane, validated URL state, a query-key factory, an approval-aware action hook, a create/edit sheet that names its env on submit, a delete confirm, and a MetricStrip with a minute popover.

items.name: investigations
items.title: Investigations
items.description: The review dashboard for an alarm-investigating DevOps agent: a list of its findings by review state with search, facets and j/k keys, and a detail pane with the cause, what it verified, the next steps, the hypotheses it weighed and a notebook of every call it made, with acknowledge and close-with-a-verdict.

items.name: assistant
items.title: Assistant
items.description: The assistant dock: a right panel that talks to POST /api/agent over AG-UI with the official client, streams answers with a quiet row per read, shows each proposed write as a card with its diff to confirm or cancel (an amber request for approval outside the direct envs), and keeps one thread per tab. Offered only when GET /api/agent/status says enabled.

items.name: mock-api
items.title: Mock API
items.description: MSW mode: the API contract answered in the browser, with seeded principals and a scripted assistant, so the console runs with no backend (`?msw=1&as=admin|editor|reviewer|viewer|empty`, `?assistant=off`).

items.name: design-doc
items.title: DESIGN.md
items.description: The visual and interaction language, and the eight component standards.

items.name: standards-tests
items.title: Standards ratchets
items.description: The tests that hold the eight standards: each scans src/ for a shape that breaks one and fails the build on it. They import from vite-plus/test.

items.name: agent-rules
items.title: Agent skills
items.description: The Claude Code skills that teach a coding agent to build on this framework: add a tool, gate an action behind approvals, expose an action to AI, change the API contract, hold the design standards, and sweep the UI with screenshots. Installs into .claude/skills/.
